about_the_game:
Hungry Ghosts is a wacky tower defense roguelike game about exorcising hordes of powerful hungry ghosts with various desserts and drinks.

Play as a fearless young witch exploring a haunted mansion, fighting off hordes of ghosts with the help of magical dishes ! Your goal is to make your way through a series of levels, fending off increasingly powerful waves of enemies by finding strong dishes, upgrading them in the shop and creating various powerful synergies !

Meet charming characters with unique abilities and discover new recipes as you explore the mansion’s different zones, defeat ghost bosses, and win the game.

  • Unique runs: Each level is procedurally generated, with unique mechanics in every area and over a hundred original ghosts.

  • Many ways to play: Discover more than a hundred dishes and a dozen characters, each with a special power that can completely change the game.

  • Handcrafted visuals: Enjoy a warm, personality-filled art style with colorful characters and ghosts.
